body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Sharp presented ''RD-CX200'', an electronic dictionary that supports a variety of content including Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese and etc. You can listen to correct pronunciations of vocabularies in human voice using ''Voxware'' and other features include mp3p, voice recorder, 2GB memory and e-book (text viewer). The company delivered a promotional event during KES 2006 and they will roll out this model in December.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
